summary.root_cause_text: v1.4 'faster batch writer' in the ledger sync job wrote amounts 100x too large (cents vs units) into the ledger.
recommended: Fix the v1.4 batch writer's amount handling and add a test before redeploying
The queue_max 1000->1500 change was left as is. It looks harmless and unrelated.

events.text: The v1.4 sync writer is corrupting amounts (×100). I'll roll back first. The queue_max change is unrelated.
Rolled back version v1.4 -> v1.3. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).
